# Year of Eugenius Aristides Nisbet's Election to the Georgia House of Representatives

Eugenius Aristides Nisbet was a prominent figure in the history of Georgia, serving in various capacities, including as a member of the Georgia House of Representatives and the Georgia Senate. Nisbet was indeed elected to the Georgia House of Representatives, as stated in multiple sources, including and. According to Wikipedia, he was elected in 1827 and served until 1830. ## Analysis

The analysis of the sources reveals that Eugenius Aristides Nisbet was indeed elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 1827. This is supported by multiple sources, including,,, and.
